instruction: The slide panel on the left side seems to have disappeared. Please restore it so I can see all my slides in the panel.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=11, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task requires restoring the left slide panel in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator checks for 'Slides View' in the accessibility tree to verify the panel is visible.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to restore the slides panel
Metric function uses correct parameter handling pattern for type='rule' (accesses expected.get('panel_name') directly, not expected.get('rules', {}))
Semantic verification is sound: searches for document-frame with name 'Slides View' in accessibility tree, which correctly identifies if the panel is visible
Complete coverage: instruction only requires verifying panel visibility, which the evaluator checks exactly
Proper error handling: try-except block gracefully handles XML parsing errors by returning 0.0
Data flow is correct: accessibility_tree (XML string) -> parse XML -> search for correct element -> return 1.0 if found, 0.0 otherwise
